** VIRTUAL TOUR AVAILABLE BY REQUEST **

MySherryFitz Online Portal: To view current offers or place your own offer on this property, please visit SherryFitz.ie and register for your mySherryFitz account.

Sherry FitzGerald Gleeson are delighted to present Apt. 9, Dun Aoibhinn, Slievenamon Road, Thurles, Co. Tipperary to the market, comprising a spacious 3-Bed Penthouse Apartment extending to approximately 1,100 Sq.Ft. and situated within this highly regarded and well-established residential development in the heart of Thurles.

Originally built by Clancy Construction c. 1995, Dun Aoibhinn is an exclusive development of just 10 Apartments, including only 2 Penthouse Apartments, making this a particularly rare opportunity to acquire a property within one of Thurles' most sought-after apartment schemes. Apt. 9 is accessed via a central stairwell shared by just 3 other Apartments, offering an added sense of privacy and exclusivity.

Ideally located on Slievenamon Road, directly opposite Lidl and Thurles Shopping Centre (including Dunnes Stores), the property enjoys immediate access to a wide range of shops, services and amenities, while Thurles Town Centre, Thurles Train Station, Mary Immaculate College (MIC), TUS Midlands Campus (TÚS) and all other local facilities are within a short walk.

Accommodation includes Entrance Hall with private hallway and large overhead skylight, spacious open-plan Kitchen / Dining / Living Room, 3 no. double Bedrooms (Master En-Suite), main Bathroom and Hotpress. The Apartment benefits from excellent natural light, with generous glazing throughout and a bright central hallway illuminated by a large rooflight.

Externally, residents benefit from beautifully maintained mature landscaped communal gardens surrounding the development, together with a designated car parking space, additional visitor parking and private lock-up storage units (one per apartment) located to the rear.

Heating is provided by modern Farho electric heaters, there are double glazed windows throughout and all mains services are connected.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire one of only two Penthouse Apartments within this exclusive 10-unit development. Offering spacious accommodation, excellent natural light and an unrivalled town centre location, Apt. 9 will appeal to owner-occupiers, downsizers, first-time buyers and investors alike seeking a low-maintenance property in one of Thurles' most established residential developments.

A virtual tour link can be supplied on request with in-person viewings strictly by appointment. Further enquiries can be made by contacting Sole Selling Agents, Sherry FitzGerald Gleeson in Thurles.
